ImageListDirectory.description: Save and load batches of images from a directory.

ImageBatchLogicFilter.description: Boolean condition output for image batches.

MultiLineTextInput.description: Output lines from multiline text in sequential, random, or index mode.

FishS2TokenEstimator.description: Estimate Fish Audio S2 TTS token count and audio duration.

BatchImageSaveToPath.description: Save an image batch to any folder with a clear-or-append switch; re-runs every time, so it is safe inside loops.

SelectEveryNthImage.description: Keep every Nth image of a batch (indices 0, N, 2N, ...) to down-sample video frames.

Florence2LabelDedup.description: Merge Florence2 detection labels from many frames into one de-duplicated tag list.

LyricAlignLRC.description: Align known lyrics to a song (lyric-align CLI) or transcribe it with faster-whisper, and output LRC/SRT/VTT/ASS/TTML.

FlywaySubtitleTranslate.description: Cut word-level timestamped text into subtitle lines (SRT/WebVTT), with optional translation; segmentation supports a punctuation-rule mode or an LLM-grouping mode.

FlywayOllamaTranslate.description: Standalone Ollama translation node that translates an existing SRT/WebVTT file directly, with an optional image for multimodal context.

FlywayTTSMerge.description: Read a translated SRT, generate speech per line with FishAudioS2, align each line to its time slot, and stitch one full audio track with optional background mixing.

FlywayH3MotionContextDir.description: Read the previous clip's tail frames from a folder and anchor them at frame 0 of the next clip; skips on an empty folder, with an optional clear-first switch.

FlywayH3MotionContextImage.description: Same as the Directory version, but the previous clip's frames arrive as an IMAGE batch - built for carrying state through a For Loop.

FlywayImageBatchExtendOverlap.description: Join a new clip onto the frames so far, dropping the duplicated overlap frames, with an optional disk cache - built for stitching a video together clip by clip inside a Loop.

FlywayAudioBatchExtendOverlap.description: Audio counterpart of the image version: trims overlap in seconds and auto-resamples, with an optional disk cache - built for keeping the soundtrack in sync inside a Loop.
